author: spidey simp
description: A collection of tools for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, including Kyrotech farming estimates and relic material calculations.
install_msg: SWGOHTools contains specialized Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes farming and progression utilities and is not currently intended for general installation.
short: Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes tools
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and user-selected game settings used for farming calculations, including Territory Battle progress, Territory War GP, energy spending, and other progression settings.
